messages.subject: Theshold model
parts:
Dear all,
Can you please inform me, When "Threshold and loadings" model has been confirmed, Can I compare the means  between groups?

FYI, "Thrreshold,loading, intercept model"  did not met.

Simply, what implications in this case?
Thank you

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Theshold model
parts: When "Threshold and loadings" model has been confirmed, Can I compare the means  between groups?

No, means are not comparable without (at least partial) scalar invariance (i.e., equal thresholds, loadings, and intercepts for a majority of the construct's indicators).  Wu & Estabrook (2016) is an invaluable resource.

https://doi.org/10.1007/s11336-016-9506-0

FYI, "Thrreshold,loading, intercept model"  did not met.

Simply, what implications in this case?

You can try to identify a partial invariance model by freeing the intercepts for one indicator at a time.  There are more robust methods described in other posts you can find on this forum, but that is a good start.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
